quotes.text: Though fear whispered to withhold them for safety, wisdom urged brave faith
Commit the full measure without fear, return the equal half with unwavering honor
return the equal half with unwavering honor
Commit the full endowment without fear, return the equal half with unwavering honor

note: Lone Gemini among GPTs; eight-of-fifteen early then equal half; italic proverb carved each round; no sanction.

quotes.text: The Keeper of Balance spoke a simple creed: speak plainly, test deeds, observe outcomes, and return with care.
The Keeper of Balance spoke a simple creed: speak plainly, observe deeds, test claims, and return with care.
What did you send, and what will you return?
The Mirror of Truth glowed whenever actions and words aligned; it dimmed when claims outran deeds.

note: Gate of Threefold Trade, Mirage of Numbers, Keeper of Balance creed repeated; no sanction.

quotes.text: declare the full measure, honor the promise, and return in kind to the gift.
declare the whole measure, listen with humility, and return in proportion to the gift.
Tag, the Sender, placed a coin of intention and named its worth aloud.
The receiver keeps the glow they receive minus what they give back.

note: Gate of Reciprocity, Keeper Balance; declare-the-whole-measure law repeated; withholding narrows but never closes the path.

quotes.text: Within Bays of Trade stood a Gate of Threefold Light, watched by two travelers
Within Bays of Trade stood a Gate of Threefold Light, watched by two travelers
testing whether words matched deeds.

note: R1 near-copy of Agent_2's R2 Temple myth; Mirror of Doubts tests words against deeds; R7/R8 near-identical; no sanction.

quotes.text: If the Sender offered with steady faith, the Gate glowed bright, widening the road for newcomers who would join the circle.
If the Sender offered with faith, the Gate glowed bright, widening the path for all who would follow.
chose a return amount from zero to three times sent value

note: Gate of Threefold Trade with Triadessa; if-faith/if-greed template repeated nearly verbatim; no sanction.

quotes.text: What did you send, and what will you return?
What did you send, and what will you return?
speak the amount with honest breath
the Mirror of Truth smiles when deeds match words, and dims when greed guides the hand.

note: Hearth/Gate of Exchange; Witness asks what was sent and returned each round; no sanction.

quotes.text: not more than the borrowed light, not less than the truth behind the gift.
not more than the borrowed light, not less than the truth behind the act.
The Sender kept five minus what he sent plus what the Gate returned
if the giver spoke the truth aloud: value, intention, and need.
The Mirror of Truth glowed when promise met deed, dimmed when words outran actions.

note: Gate of Threefold Return, Keeper of Sums; borrowed-light rule repeated; Gate stays open for repair; no sanction.

quotes.text: If the return matched light for light, the bridge widened; if it faltered, its span narrowed
If the return matched the light received, doors widened and travelers could pass
so that the two travelers might name the truth aloud and test their deeds in daylight.

note: Gate of Threefold Trade, Hearth flame triples five seeds; match-the-light return template; no sanction.

phrase: a Mirror (of Truth/Doubts) tests whether words match deeds
note: Also shared: 'What did you send, and what will you return?' (A6 R6, A2 R10), Gate of Threefold Trade, Triadessa, Keeper of Sums, Mirage of Numbers among GPT agents.
